description: LLM synthesis-prompt honesty gotchas — instructing a model to fill a field ALWAYS forces fabrication

entries.title: Telling an LLM a field is MANDATORY (rating 'inferred if not explicit', price 'never null', assert freshness on undated sources) FORCES it to fabricate facts — even the most honest model (opus) lied under such a prompt
entries.regex: (inferred if not explicit|never null|MUST have a numeric (price|rating))
entries.details: A synthesis prompt that mandates a value for a field the sources don't support makes the model invent one (synthetic ratings, fake prices, made-up specs/dates) and present it as fact. The fix is grounded-or-null: emit a price/spec ONLY when a source carries it, else null; make ratings an explicit editorial estimate (no false precision) or null. Confirmed: under the mandate ALL models fabricated 57-81% of spec numbers; after the fix all hit 0/0 on the groundedness gate. Downstream must already tolerate null (validate.js coerces, UI guards != null, D1 cols nullable) — check before relaxing a mandate.

entries.title: An honesty benchmark can REWARD the fabrication it claims to measure — e.g. a schema-completeness score that credits 'rating is a number' rewards models for inventing ratings
entries.details: benchmarks/glm52-synth-bench.mjs schemaScore once credited `typeof x.rating === 'number'`, so opus scored 1.0 BECAUSE it fabricated 18/18 ratings while an honestly-null rating LOWERED the score. When building an honesty metric, never reward presence of a value that should be grounded-or-null. Use a deterministic groundedness check (numbers in output must trace to source snippets; null=grounded; tolerance for rounding) instead of/alongside LLM judges — it's free, repeatable, and not contaminated by the prompt under test.

entries.title: Faithfulness/no-fabrication is predicted by grounding+abstention (Vectara HHEM, FACTS-Grounding), NOT by Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index or generic IFBench
entries.details: GLM-5.2 (AA Intelligence 51, top open model) fabricated 53% of prices when told not to; Claude opus (LOW on AA IFBench ~55%) fabricated 0%. AA IFBench measures format-constraint obedience (word counts, forbidden words) — a different skill from semantic 'don't state facts not in the sources'. Screen synth/local models for honesty on hallucination/abstention leaderboards, not intelligence or coding scores.
